data.store_name: Koky Bistro Puerto Rican Cuisine & Bar
data.status: "expected to open in about a month"
data.short_description: Koky Bistro is a new Puerto Rican concept coming to Cicero, IL, serving dishes like mofongo, raices urbano, and burgers. It is currently hiring for host, bartender, and line cook positions.

data.location: 4727 SE Woodstock Blvd (commercial kitchen address not announced)
data.status: "hoping to hit the ground running in October"
data.short_description: Cookie McCakeface, known for its giant cookie cart, is expanding into a new commercial kitchen space with plans for a future walk-up window. Wholesale options are expected to start in October with shipping following in early 2027.

data.status: "getting ready to open" / "current target for completion is Spring 2027"
data.short_description: The Butcher's Wife is a planned American restaurant with a full bar coming to the former Old Trieste property in San Diego. The project is led by Joey Vaught, with plans continuing after co-collaborator Tony D'Amato's death in June.
Old Trieste, an Italian fine dining restaurant open since 1963, closed in May 2019 after about 56 years in business.

Barefoot Juice Co. is a grab-and-go juice and food concept preparing to open in downtown Monroe's former Gingham Girl space, owned by Katie Cook. Menu, hours, and opening date have not yet been announced.
Gingham Girl previously occupied the downtown Monroe storefront now being taken over by Barefoot Juice Co. and has since relocated.

7 Brew Coffee is set to open a new drive-thru stand at 101 W Woodlawn Road in Charlotte after receiving a commercial variance approval. The stand will feature double drive-thru lanes and a full customizable beverage menu.

data.location: 9659 S Santa Monica Blvd, Beverly Hills, CA 90210
data.status: "getting ready to open" / no opening date announced
data.short_description: Blank Street Coffee is preparing to open a new location in Beverly Hills, its second Los Angeles location after Studio City. Signs are up at the property, but no opening date has been announced.
A new 2,000-square-foot Starbucks with indoor seating, a 20-seat patio, and a drive-thru is coming to Jonquière. Construction is expected to start next month.

data.status: "preparing to open" / exact opening date not announced
data.short_description: Taroko Sports, a sports and entertainment facility with batting cages, arcade games, and dining, is preparing to open in Northridge, marking its first California location. It will occupy a 20,587-square-foot space previously home to Burlington Coat Factory.

data.location: 263 Lakeshore Rd E, Oakville, ON L6J 1J1
data.status: "opening" / "listed opening date online right now is Nov. 9"
data.short_description: Papi Chulo's is preparing to open its first location outside Toronto city limits in Oakville, bringing the same menu and energy as its Ossington Avenue original. A Mistletoes & Margaritas pop-up will accompany the opening during the holidays.

data.status: "gearing up to serve its final plate" / closing permanently
data.short_description: Oven and Shaker, a Neapolitan pizza and cocktail restaurant, is closing after more than 15 years due to rising costs and declining revenue. The team plans a celebratory final month featuring past menu favorites and a special cocktail menu.

The Fieldhouse Tavern, a food-focused sports bar from Tom and Brandon Brock, is coming to The Grounds development in Winston-Salem. The two-story concept will include a rooftop bar and chef-driven dishes.

Cunard Tavern in East Boston is closing after nearly a decade due to changing market trends and customer dynamics. Owner Phil Frattaroli plans to open a new restaurant in the same space in spring 2027.
Dear Grain is opening a new bakery at Shops at The James in Summerhill, Toronto, part of a larger expansion by Big League Food Company.
Dear Grain's second new Toronto bakery is planned for the Waterworks complex on Richmond Street West as part of Big League Food Company's expansion.

Baekjeong Black is a new 8,000-square-foot Korean barbecue restaurant opening in New York's Koreatown, marking the brand's return to the city after a two-year absence. It includes Yangban, a ground-floor cocktail bar, alongside the upstairs Korean barbecue dining.

data.status: "Our final day of service will be Saturday, September 26th" / retiring
data.short_description: Maria's Buena Cocina, a beloved Mexican restaurant in Highland, is closing permanently after 30 years as the owners retire. The community has shared an outpouring of support and farewell messages on social media.

data.location: 2271 N Belt Line Rd, Irving, TX 75062
data.short_description: Angie's, a fast-growing fast food platform, opened its 26th location and third Texas location in Irving, offering premium proteins and made-to-order bowls, salads, and burritos. The location includes a drive-thru, online ordering, and dine-in options.

data.status: "reopened" under new ownership with refreshed space
data.short_description: Finnigan's Wake has reopened on Trade Street in Winston-Salem under new ownership, featuring a refreshed space, streamlined menu, and a new hangout/pool area. It remains open seven days a week in the downtown Arts District.

Cut Club is a new modern steakhouse from Chef Ethan Stowell, now open adjacent to Hotel Max in downtown Seattle. It offers all-day dining, happy hour, an oyster and raw bar, and premium grilled steaks.
Carnegie Diner & Cafe is opening its first Brooklyn location at City Point, its eighth location nationwide, offering American comfort food in a 4,500-square-foot, 150-seat space.
Sixpoint Brewery previously occupied the City Point space in Downtown Brooklyn now being taken over by Carnegie Diner & Cafe.

Green Acres Nursery & Supply is building a new garden center on the site of a former Toys R Us in Modesto, which had sat vacant for eight years. Demolition of the original structure began in late August.
Toys R Us previously occupied the Modesto site that has sat vacant for eight years and is now being redeveloped for Green Acres Nursery & Supply.

A golf simulator franchise is coming to White Lake, run by father-son duo Corey and Michael Brabandt. They hope to debut before the end of the year, with three bays initially and two more planned later.

data.status: planned for; permitting records list construction expected complete by February 2027
data.short_description: Los Angeles-based clothing brand Brochu Walker is planning a store on South Congress Avenue in Austin. It would be the brand's first dedicated retail presence in the city, following earlier plans to enter the market.
Australian boot brand Blundstone is opening a storefront in Portland's Northwest District, taking over a former Verizon space. This will be only its sixth dedicated U.S. storefront.
Sephora will open a new 4,200-square-foot location in Manhattan's Meatpacking District, next to the Apple store. It will offer cosmetics, skin care, fragrances, and beauty services.

data.status: opening date will be sometime in spring 2027
data.short_description: Planet Oil Change Centers is expanding to Farmington Hills with a new location offering oil changes, tire rotations, transmission services, and car washes.

data.status: signage points to a fall opening
data.short_description: Gap Factory is taking over an 8,000-square-foot space at Clackamas Promenade that previously hosted Party City, Spirit Halloween, and Furniture Factory Outlet. It will be Gap Factory's third Oregon location.

data.status: will open its latest location this fall
data.short_description: The Wardrobe, a thrift store that gives back to the community, will open at Lincoln Court Shopping Center, taking over a former Goodwill space, after its Exton Square Mall store closed.
Fitness studio [solidcore] is opening a 3,023-square-foot studio at The Shoppes at English Village, offering its signature 50-minute reformer-based workout classes.
JP's Pastry, a gluten-free bakery, is opening its first Triad location in Greensboro, investing $30,000–$40,000 into the site. It has already opened three Triangle locations in the past two years.

data.location: 412 NW N River Dr, Miami, FL 33128
data.short_description: The team behind Seaspice is opening AIR, an intimate French-Asian fine-dining restaurant above Seaspice on the Miami River, featuring a nine-course tasting menu led by chef Vinh Nguyen.
Cascara Coffee is opening its third location in downtown Fenton, joining a building with Fenton Pilates Studio. Construction is underway, with prior locations in Rochester Hills and Clio.

data.location: 4235 Chukka Ln, Suite 105, Lake Wellington, FL 33467
data.status: opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Jersey Mike's Subs is expanding in South Florida with a new restaurant planned for Wellington, after permit applications were filed by JM Lakeworth LLC.

data.location: 7170 S Dixie Hwy, West Palm Beach, FL 33405
data.short_description: Parma Palm Beach, an Italian-inspired café led by Joseph J. Acierno of Joseph's Classic Market, is opening in West Palm Beach's SoSo neighborhood with sandwiches, wraps, and pastries.

data.status: under construction, opening date still to be determined
data.short_description: Franchise company The Hari Group is building a new Dave's Hot Chicken in Bloomingdale, joining chains like Qdoba in the area.
Renowned NYC bagel shop Ess-a-Bagel is expanding with a new downtown location, joining several existing NYC shops. It's known for kettle-boiled bagels and is certified kosher.

data.status: opening date will reportedly be sometime in 2027
data.short_description: Owner Melanie McElroy is opening a permanent burger, butcher shop, cafe, and bakery space in Hamtramck after running a successful pop-up since 2023.
Chef Chaz Brown and partners are opening Rumblefish, a fast-casual Trinidadian restaurant in Olde Kensington focused on invasive species like lionfish and catfish, alongside classic fish fry sides.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Cuban bakery Vicky Bakery is expanding to Oakwood Plaza in Hollywood with a 2,200-square-foot space, joining other new tenants like Total Wine & More and Dick's House of Sport.

data.location: 404 NW N River Dr, Miami, FL 33128
data.short_description: Nicola Siervo, in partnership with Roman Jones of House Kiki, is opening Mercante, a 175-seat Italian restaurant and piano bar on the Miami River inspired by the Italian Riviera.

data.status: currently hiring ahead of an impending opening; opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: The Sand Bar, a flagship beach bar in Waveland, will offer live music, fresh Gulf seafood, an open-air ground floor bar, and a climate-controlled second floor oyster bar with patio seating.

Studio Pilates is opening its first Midtown Manhattan location, a 2,500-square-foot space owned by Brooklyn resident Maggie Romnios. The studio offers 40-minute reformer Pilates workouts and is located near the site of Joseph and Clara Pilates' original NY studio.

data.location: 9135 Carothers Pkwy #100, Franklin, TN 37067, United States
data.short_description: Tin Roof 2, a Franklin sports bar of 20 years, is closing after a dispute with the Franklin Police Department and a Beer Board hearing that resulted in a permit suspension and fine. The bar will close its doors on October 9.

Rancho Cantina, a family-owned Californio restaurant, has opened its newest location in Danville. The restaurant offers wood-fired vaquero platters and is running grand opening promotions including a $500 free tacos giveaway.

Spread Bagelry is opening another Atlanta location at 820 Ralph McGill Blvd in Midtown, joining its existing Buckhead location. The Philadelphia-based bagel brand currently has 12 locations including two in Georgia.

data.status: Expected to open later this fall
data.short_description: Luga is bringing a chef-driven Italian dining experience to Decatur from chef Robbie Pacheco, with Florence-inspired design elements. Menu highlights include gamberi and a 40-ounce dry-aged porterhouse.
The Scoop N Scootery is opening its first location in Georgia, as part of Metro Atlanta's new restaurant developments reported by WhatNow Atlanta.

Incline Cider House's Tacoma taproom is closing after seven years as the lease on its Brewery District location ends. The company will remain open and continue retail sales while searching for a new taproom location.

H. Valley, a Hudson Valley-inspired market from chef Austin Johnson and restaurateur Eytan Sugarman, is opening in New York's West Village. The 24-seat market will offer prepared foods, seasonal produce, groceries, and a dog-food line.

data.status: Upcoming opening, official date not yet announced
data.short_description: Snap Fitness Cumming, a 24/7 boutique-style gym from owners Jack Ryan and Greg Mooneyham, is opening as their fourth Atlanta-area club. Discounted early-access Founder Memberships are currently available.

data.event_date: Not specified (in the next couple of years)
data.short_description: Brothers Alan and Eddie Gant are bringing Zaxbys to Kosciusko, Mississippi, following a Winona location planned first. Kosciusko is expected to follow approximately a year after Winona opens.

data.status: Storefront customer-ready within the next year
data.short_description: Brothers Alan and Eddie Gant, along with Alan's son Stefan, are bringing Zaxbys to Winona, Mississippi. The team anticipates having the storefront customer-ready within the next year.

data.location: 947 Eglinton Ave W, York, ON M6C 2C3, Canada
data.short_description: Woodlyns, a new neighborhood restaurant from Jeff Goldstein and chef Josh Ling with culinary director Nick Liu, is opening in Toronto. Menu highlights include whole steamed branzino and a pastrami sandwich.

data.location: Address not specified (Quartier Villeray, per Silo57)
data.status: Early stages of development, timeline not announced
data.short_description: Caron & Frères is opening a third cafe location, reportedly in Quartier Villeray, coinciding with the brand's fourth anniversary. The Caron brothers currently operate cafes in Montreal and Knowlton.

data.status: It is unclear when the new location will open
data.short_description: Roti Mediterranean is seeking to join Forsyth Town Center, expanding its Atlanta-area presence beyond its current Smyrna location. Edible Brands acquired Roti in 2025.

data.status: Yet to be built out; likely to open in 2027
data.short_description: Decoy, an "eatertainment" restaurant-bar, is relocating within Gainesville from 123 Green Street to 104 Main Street. The new space was still not built out as of late July and is expected to open in 2027.

data.status: Currently closed for repairs (estimated about two weeks)
data.short_description: Little Jack's Tavern is temporarily closed due to a roof leak causing a serious electrical issue requiring immediate repair. Repairs are estimated to take about two weeks before reopening.

data.store_name: Biscuit Belly (replacing Maple Street Biscuit Company)
data.location: 1191 Medical Center Dr, Nashville, TN 37232, USA
data.event_date: Not specified (conversion date to be determined)
data.short_description: Murfreesboro's Maple Street Biscuit Company will transition to Biscuit Belly as part of a Louisville-based brand's acquisition of 34 Maple Street locations. Conversions are expected over the next 18 to 24 months.

data.status: Permit filed for tenant finish-out; no opening date listed
data.short_description: Village Whiskey, a whiskey-and-burger concept created by Chef Jose Garces, is coming to Nashville with a new location at 900 Division St, according to a Nashville ePermits filing.

data.location: 316 W Cabarrus St, Raleigh, NC 27601, USA
data.short_description: Legends, a longtime LGBTQ+ entertainment venue, is relocating within downtown Raleigh's Warehouse District to a roughly 10,000-square-foot space. The current location's final weekend is October 16-18.

data.status: Construction underway; expected to open Fall 2027
data.short_description: Bagels & Co. is set to open its first North Carolina location at The Grounds, a 100-acre mixed-use development near Wake Forest University, as part of the development's Retail & Dining Village.

data.status: Getting ready to open; anticipates being customer-ready this October
data.short_description: Nissan Cafe, helmed by restaurateur John Tierre, is opening in The Two Mississippi Museums as a collaboration between Nissan, John Tierre Hospitality, and the museums.

Joia Burger, from Purple Patch founder Patrice Cleary, is bringing its smash burger menu to Capital One Arena's 100 Level Concourse, Section 105, adding to its existing Mt. Pleasant and Glover Park locations.

Vanessa Holmes opened Scrapped The Plate Bistro, turning her food truck concept into a brick-and-mortar restaurant in Memphis. The concept debuted earlier this month after three and a half months of preparation.

data.status: finalizing the permitting processes necessary for opening
data.short_description: A popular Memphis breakfast food truck is working on its first storefront at Hickory Ridge Mall. The concept has a certificate of occupancy under review for the 803-square-foot space.
Lovettsville favorite Train to Mumbai is opening a second location in Purcellville, taking over the former Purcellville Eats storefront. No opening timeline has been announced yet.

data.status: plan review application submitted, listed as "In process"
data.short_description: A new restaurant called Grand Restaurant is planned for the former Fushimi Grill & Modern Buffet space, reportedly from the same owners. Yi Liu is identified as the owner in state records.

data.store_name: Fushimi Grill & Modern Buffet (Atlantic Boulevard location)
data.short_description: Fushimi announced on social media in June that its Atlantic Boulevard location would officially close July 1. Guests were told they could continue visiting its River City Marketplace location.
Park Pass Coffee is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar cafe in Denver's Berkley/Highlands area. The company signed a lease and plans to begin construction soon.
Harold's Bar is a classic American bar concept from Sam Norman, opening in downtown Knoxville's Market Square. It occupies the former Alice in Appalachia space.
Bertie Rose will bring a modern Southern breakfast and lunch concept to Market Square in downtown Knoxville. It shares the location with two other new concepts from Sam Norman.
Royal Spud will operate as a walk-up Dutch fry shop in downtown Knoxville's Market Square. It is one of three concepts being developed by Sam Norman at the former Alice in Appalachia space.

data.location: Goose Creek, SC (specific address not specified)
data.short_description: Gilligan's Seafood closed its Goose Creek location about two months ago due to the high cost of renovating the 7,000-square-foot building. The company is currently searching for a new, smaller Goose Creek location.
Gilligan's Seafood is preparing to renovate its Moncks Corner restaurant, described as "an update." The store expects to remain open for most of the process, closing only about a week.
Spinx, a South Carolina fueling station and convenience store chain, is building a new location at 3620 Augusta Road in West Columbia. The store is situated near Pulga Lexington.
Quarter French, a "French-ish neighborhood bistro" from King Street Hospitality, is opening at 40 Broad St in Charleston. It will feature a courtyard, breakfast, lunch, dinner and a wine list.

data.location: 30 Liberty St, Rittman, OH 44270 (inside Sweet Harmony Canal, Canal Winchester)
data.short_description: Jam Jam, a new Cajun restaurant from Justin Boehme, is preparing to open its first brick-and-mortar location inside Sweet Harmony Canal in Canal Winchester. Initial hours are planned Tuesday through Friday, 5 to 9 p.m.

data.location: 440 W Bay Dr, Largo, FL 33770 (Horizon West Bay)
data.short_description: Bocelli Modern Italian, an Italian restaurant with traditional and modern dishes, will open at the Horizon West Bay development in Largo in 2027. The lease was approved by the City of Largo last month.

Barberry, a new brasserie from Emmer & Rye Hospitality Group, is preparing to open at the reimagined Sítio El Tropicano on the San Antonio River Walk. It will initially launch with dinner service before expanding to all-day dining.
Storm Healthy Energy, a Tampa-based clean energy drink shop with three existing locations, will open its first St. Petersburg location this fall in a building formerly home to Grand Kitchen and Bath.

data.event_date: Construction begins October 30, 2026; completion by March 26, 2027
data.short_description: Tia's Taco Hut is planning a new 2,500-square-foot restaurant in Schertz, Texas, according to TDLR project records. The San Antonio-based Tex-Mex chain's project has an estimated construction cost of $250,000.

Nonna's Empanada is a new gluten-free, family-operated food trailer serving empanadas from Empanada Brothers, launching in Pinellas County this fall. The menu will include empanadas, fries, yucca fries, and coffee drinks.

data.location: 440 W Bay Dr, Largo, FL 33770 (Horizon West Bay)
data.short_description: Dead Bob's is expanding with Live at Dead Bob's, a new venue at Largo's Horizon West Bay development featuring an outdoor stage and late-night hours. It will offer the same beloved burger and wings menu with indoor and outdoor seating.
All Day Darling is building a second Asheville location on the city's East Side at 567 Fairview Road. No opening date has been given, and the site is currently in early construction stages.
Tifosi Pizza and Trattoria is preparing to open in Irvine, combining pizza, Italian sandwiches, and a trattoria menu with a bar program. A specific opening date was not available in public sources.
Go Greek Yogurt is preparing to open a new location at Irvine Spectrum Center, following its Orange County debut in Newport Beach. Eduardo Licona is the franchisee behind the expansion.

data.location: 1221 W. Coast Highway, Newport Beach, CA 92663
data.short_description: Bar nineteen48 is preparing to debut at Balboa Bay Resort in Newport Beach as part of the resort's 2026 renovation. The bar overlooks the resort's pool and features a mid-century-inspired design.

Naomi Roasters LLC is moving through the permitting process for a new restaurant and bar at 832 Seigle Ave., filing for an ABC inspection. The space is a standalone ~3,780 sq ft second-generation hospitality build-out with a commercial kitchen, bar, patio and parking. No opening date, menu, or additional ownership details have been announced.

data.location: Deer Valley Rd, Antioch, CA 94531 (The Crossings Shopping Center)
data.short_description: Butter Pecan Bakeshop is opening a new franchise location in Antioch, owned by local residents Dale and Desiree Ingram. The shop offers a variety of cookie flavors plus rotating monthly specials, and is scheduled to open October 2nd.

data.event_date: early October (per The Almanac); website lists September 2026
data.short_description: Coffeebar is opening a new location at 170 State St. in Los Altos, part of its Peninsula expansion. The shop will eventually serve as the company's main pastry production facility for Bay Area stores, with pastries initially supplied from Menlo Park during a soft-opening period.

Durham-based wood-fired pizzeria Pizzeria Toro is expanding to Raleigh with a new location at Seaboard Station, sharing space with The Common Market. The Raleigh menu will rotate seasonal items and won't duplicate the Durham menu exactly.

data.location: 747 W Dana St, Mountain View, CA 94041
data.short_description: Tong Sui, a Sunnyvale-founded dessert and beverage concept, is opening a new location in Mountain View. The shop will offer coconut puddings, fruit smoothies, and tea beverages as part of the brand's continued Bay Area expansion.

The Jimmy, from the team behind Rooster's and Copain, is opening a new restaurant and bar at The Grounds' Retail & Dining Village in Winston-Salem, featuring wood-fired pizzas, a chophouse-style menu, and rooftop dining.

Abanico Coffee Roasters is preparing to open at 424 Irving St. in San Francisco's Inner Sunset neighborhood. The concept is a roaster and café rooted in Latin American culture, offering espresso-based drinks and brewed coffee; a full menu was not yet available.

data.location: 301 W. Cabarrus St., Suite 200, Raleigh, NC
data.short_description: Pizzeria di Territorio, planned for downtown Raleigh's Warehouse District, will be a full-service Italian restaurant centered on artisanal Neapolitan pizza using DOP-certified ingredients and local produce, from owner Brian Wojick.

data.location: 301 W. Cabarrus St., Suite 200, Raleigh, NC
data.short_description: Stoccaggio, an intimate 25-30 seat speakeasy sharing the space with Pizzeria di Territorio, will offer Italian-inspired small plates and prohibition-era-influenced cocktails, wine, and an evening-focused atmosphere.

Happea's Mediterranean Grill, a Miami-based fast-casual Mediterranean concept founded by brothers-in-law Eduardo and Danny, is opening a new Aventura location, adding to its existing Brickell restaurant.

data.location: 9929 S Military Trl, Boynton Beach, FL 33436
data.short_description: Pinecrest Bakery, a Cuban-American bakery concept, is preparing to open a roughly 3,000-square-foot location with 20-30 indoor seats in Boynton Beach, on a site previously occupied by Boston Market. No final opening date was established.

Hadeem, a California-Jewish restaurant from chef Spencer Horovitz, is preparing to open a permanent location in San Francisco's Lower Haight, taking over the space currently occupied by Otra. The menu draws on Horovitz's Hadeem pop-ups and family heritage.

data.status: may be coming; not yet announced
data.short_description: ABC records suggest burger concept Smish Smash could be planning a new Berkeley location. The company, which currently operates in San Francisco, has not announced a specific opening date, hours, or final menu for the site.

data.location: 1710 E Hallandale Beach Blvd, Hallandale Beach, FL 33009
data.short_description: WASAII Buffet signed a lease for a 12,548 sq ft all-you-can-eat Asian buffet concept (Chinese, Japanese, and hot pot) at Hallandale Shopping Center. Owner Caifeng Li said the team is in final stages of preparation, with an exact date to be announced.

World Traveler Coffee Roasters is exploring a new location in Lincoln, CA, listed as a "coming soon" market on the company's website. Franchisor Lenoy Nesher confirmed early-stage planning, with no address or opening timeline available yet.

Mike & Patty's, a well-known Boston sandwich shop, is preparing to open its eighth location in Charlestown, taking over the former Johnny Pomodoro space. A "coming soon" sign has appeared in the window, but no opening date has been announced.

data.location: 431 Culver Blvd, Playa Del Rey, CA 90293
data.status: coming soon; exact opening date not announced
data.short_description: Petros, a Greek-Californian restaurant company, is opening a new location, Petros Speakeasy, at 431 Culver Blvd. in Playa del Rey, next door to its existing Petros Kafe. The company recently submitted a liquor license application for the site.

data.location: 451 Manhattan Beach Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA
data.short_description: Petros' Manhattan Beach location, open for 21 years, had its final day of service on Sunday, September 13, as announced on Instagram. The closure coincides with the company's planned opening of a new Playa del Rey location.
